title: Adaptive Starter Gallery — Hosted API onboarding screenshots and code tiles
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, adaptive gallery of getting-started visuals for the Hosted API quickstart. Deliver a set of high-fidelity screenshots (model selector, request builder, streaming snippet, and language-specific code tiles) optimized for docs, in-product quickstart modal, and marketing micro-copy. Focus on clarity for engineers who need to copy/paste minimal code and understand model selection trade-offs at a glance.
acceptance_criteria: Four primary screenshots exported: model-picker (desktop), request-builder (compact), streaming response with tool-calling badge, and code tile examples for Python/JS/Go.
Each screenshot has annotated callouts for the three top guidance points: latency vs cost, token limits, and recommended use-cases.
Assets exported in 3 sizes: full hero (1440x720), docs inline (880x320), and thumbnail (360x160) with correct device-safe padding.
Accessibility: all screenshots have contrast-checked highlights and alt-text drafts attached.
Figma file links and export artifacts uploaded to the shared drive; PR with screenshots attached for docs merged into docs repo.
assets: SVG icon set for model badges (gpt-lite, gpt-advanced, redwood-optimized)
Code tiles: python_snippet.txt, js_snippet.txt, go_snippet.txt (copiable, single-file)
Annotations overlay PNGs for callouts and keyboard focus states
export_specs: Color space: sRGB, 8-bit PNG, transparent background where applicable
Padding: 40px device-safe on full hero; 20px on docs inline; 12px on thumbnails
Font: Inter 600 for headings, Inter 400 for body; sizes 18/14/12 scaled across variants
Compression: use TinyPNG with quality target 85% for web delivery
visual_variants: Default (light) — primary marketing flavor used in docs
Compact (dark) — for console quickstart modal with dark background
International (ES/FR) — localized text layers prepared in Figma
High-contrast accessible overlay — single-shot version used in accessibility docs
implementation_notes: Request builder screenshot intentionally shows a single-step chat SDK call and a parallel raw text completion to highlight both flows
Model picker displays three recommended options with cost/latency microcopy beneath each badge rather than full tooltips to keep the screenshot readable
Code tiles limited to 6 lines + single example output to prevent long scrolling in docs
Streaming snippet highlights the event stream boundary and includes a small badge 'streaming: true' and 'partial: true' to illustrate partial token streaming
Keep sensitive keys/URLs redacted; use placeholder API keys (redwood_sk_test_123)
